data.sender_name: Kreis Musterdithmarschen – Fachdienst Waffen und Jagd (Der Landrat)

items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of hunting licence application
items.quote: Binnen eines Monats ab der Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids ist der Widerspruch zulässig; er wird schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei folgender Stelle erhoben: Kreis Musterdithmarschen, Stiftstraße 8, 25746 Musterheide in Holstein.
items.computation: Letter is dated (Bescheiddatum) 19.11.2026 (Thursday); no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date is stated, so the printed letter date counts as the posting day. The letter itself states the 4-day fiction (§ 110 Abs. 2 LVwG): day 1 = 20.11 (Fri), day 2 = 21.11 (Sat), day 3 = 22.11 (Sun), day 4 = 23.11.2026 (Mon) = deemed delivery/Bekanntgabe. For a general (non-tax) authority the delivery day itself is not shifted even onto a weekend, but here it already falls on a working Monday, so delivery = 23.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruch period runs under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe (23.11.2026) is not counted; the period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number, i.e. 23.12.2026 (a Wednesday, not a holiday in SH), so no further shift is needed.

items.title: Submit valid proof of hunting liability insurance to receive the licence without a new application
items.quote: Sobald Sie eine gültige Versicherungsbestätigung nachreichen, stelle ich den Jagdschein ohne neuen Antrag aus.
items.computation: The letter states the hunting licence will be issued as soon as a valid insurance confirmation is submitted, but gives no calendar date or period for doing so (the previously submitted proof expired on 30.06.2026). Without a stated start or length of a period, no exact final date can be computed; this is an open-ended task rather than a fixed deadline.

warnings: The letter relies on the Bescheiddatum (19.11.2026) as the posting date since no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date is given; if actual postage occurred later, the one-month Widerspruch deadline would shift accordingly.

No firm deadline is given for resubmitting the expired insurance proof; the licence will simply not be issued until this is done, and delay could affect any later Widerspruch or practical use of a hunting licence.
